title: AAPS 3.2.0.3  Samsung Galaxy Watch 5  not connected
symptom: AAPS 3.2.0.3 on phone does not show the Samsung Galaxy Watch 5 as connected in the SMART WEAR tab, even after installing the Wear-aapsclient app on the watch.
cause: The user initially used the wrong APK combination; they needed to install the matching AAPSClient and Wear AAPSClient APKs from the repository, signed with the same key.
fix: Delete the apps from both phone and watch, then install app-aapsclient-release_3.2.0.3 and wear-aapsclient-release_3.2.0.3 from the repository.
evidence_quote: I deleted the app on both my phone and watch. Installed app-aapsclient-release_3.2.0.3 wear-aapsclient-release_3.2.0.3 from your repository. Everything worked.
